name: zca-js
localSdkPatch: HTTP cookie URL/redirect policy and synchronous per-connection Listener cookie selection
crossCopyJarCompatibility: Retain parse guard; pass original Set-Cookie string to receiver jar rather than a module-local Cookie instance.
redirectSafety: Normal inputs admit only undefined or primitive manual/error; undefined defaults to error; every other value rejected before adapter without coercion. Caller Cookie/Authorization/Proxy-Authorization removed at visible origin changes including raw.
listenerSelection: Retain constructor; each new start synchronously selects current jar for full current wsURL. Recheck existing ws after synchronous lookup to refuse reentrant outer allocation; preserve existing field/lifecycle/headers/agent.
ListenerClassChange: Only synchronous start cookie selection and its post-lookup existing-socket guard change. Listener declaration/prototype graph/other methods remain unchanged.
